title: PixelSR: Pixel-Space Orthogonal Flow Decoupling for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
title_zh: PixelSR：面向真实世界图像超分的像素空间正交流解耦方法

paragraphs.en: 总结：PixelSR提出单阶段像素空间扩散Transformer，通过正交流解耦缓解真实感与结构保真的跷跷板效应，实现真实图像超分。 Latent diffusion models have recently achieved remarkable progress in Real-world Image Super-Resolution (Real-SR). However, existing methods consistently exhibit a persistent seesaw effect: enhancing perceptual realism compromises structural fidelity. This effect, we argue, is not intrinsic to diffusion models, but largely stems from the architectural constraints of prevailing two-stage frameworks. To address this challenge, we propose PixelSR, a novel single-stage Pixel Diffusion Transformer for Real-SR that operates directly in pixel space. Specifically, PixelSR consists of two core designs: Pixel-space Conditional Diffusion and Orthogonal Flow Decoupling. The former establishes an effective pixel-space restoration framework by integrating spatially aligned LR conditioning, visual semantic guidance, and lightweight texture refinement, thereby bypassing VAE compression and enabling end-to-end optimization directly in RGB space. Complementarily, the latter decomposes the asymmetric flow target into a low-rank semantic component and a noise-free orthogonal texture component. By routing these components to specialized branches, it achieves decoupled optimization with reduced mutual interference. Benefiting from these designs, our PixelSR restores perceptually realistic details while faithfully preserving structural content. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PixelSR not only achieves competitive performance, but also effectively mitigates the fidelity--realism seesaw effect.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：PixelSR提出单阶段像素空间扩散Transformer，通过正交流解耦缓解真实感与结构保真的跷跷板效应，实现真实图像超分。 潜扩散模型近来在真实世界图像超分辨率（Real-SR）任务中取得了显著进展。 然而，现有方法普遍表现出持续的跷跷板效应：提升感知真实感会损害结构保真度。 我们认为，这种效应并非扩散模型本身固有的问题，而主要源于当前流行的两阶段框架的架构限制。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出PixelSR，一种直接在像素空间运行的新型单阶段像素扩散Transformer，用于真实图像超分辨率。 具体而言，PixelSR包含两个核心设计：像素空间条件扩散与正交流解耦。 前者通过整合空间对齐的低分辨率条件、视觉语义引导和轻量级纹理细化，建立了一个有效的像素空间复原框架，从而绕过VAE压缩，实现直接在RGB空间中的端到端优化。 与之互补，后者将非对称流目标分解为低秩语义分量和无噪声的正交纹理分量。 通过将这些分量路由到专门的分支，它实现了耦合干扰降低的解耦优化。 得益于这些设计，我们的PixelSR在恢复感知真实细节的同时，忠实保留结构内容。 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，PixelSR不仅取得了具有竞争力的性能，还有效缓解了保真度与真实感之间的跷跷板效应。
